content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **HTTP and Web APIs** as part of **Serialization, Networking, and Application Integration**. Integration code must validate external data, handle timeouts and failure states, keep credentials outside source control, and test boundary behavior. Use the subtopics—HTTP Requests and Responses, REST API Concepts, Status Codes, Headers, and Content Types—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Professional applications need repeatable tests, clear APIs, dependable dependencies, security checks, and observable failures. Apply this concept in small steps before integrating it into a larger project.
